nodes.label: Tiered Rate Limiting Architecture
nodes.rationale: Multi-layer failed-attempt rate limiter (IP, Account, Combined) with fail-closed guarantee.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Security Policy
nodes.rationale: In production, missing/unreachable Upstash Redis fails closed (503) to prevent unthrottled brute force.

nodes.label: Reverse-Proxy & Ingress Trust Assumptions
nodes.rationale: Edge proxy headers (cf-connecting-ip, x-real-ip) must be stripped/overwritten by edge proxy before reaching Node.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern & Storage Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Decoupled storage interface allowing seamless switching between in-memory fallback and Supabase RLS.

nodes.label: Eventsika Technology Stack
nodes.rationale: Next.js 16, React 19, Vanilla CSS Modules, Upstash Redis, Supabase.

nodes.label: Eventsika Platform Overview
nodes.rationale: High-conversion curated event planning and vendor onboarding engine.
